Name: Friends of Mineral Town Farm
Author: KingSlothra
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Friends of Mineral Town Farm adds a new farm type to the farm select screen. It is a love letter to Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town and to ConcernedApe's Stardew Valley: a 100x80 riverside farm in the classic Mineral Farm layout, with a two-floor quarry, a hidden cellar hot spring and a memorial garden. Standard Farm and other farm types are untouched. Intended for new saves.
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and Farm Type Manager if you don't have them.
2. Unzip the download into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. You should end up with three folders: FoMTFarm, FoMTFarm_Spawns and FoMTFarmHelper.
3. Start the game and begin a new save.
4. On the farm select screen, pick "Friends of Mineral Town Farm".[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]THE FARM
- A 100x80 riverside farm in the classic Mineral Farm layout: farmhouse at the north edge, a big open field, a pond with a cherry-tree island, stone paths and a fenced spouse yard behind the house.
- Every building can be moved through Robin. The whole property is tillable except the obvious spots (water, cliffs, paths).
- A cave and shrine in their own offshoot, a bridge into the forest and a bus stop exit on the west side.
- Blue and regular grass grow in an even mix.

THE QUARRY
- Two floors in the southeast. The top floor spawns stone, copper, iron and worms. The lower floor spawns geodes, gems and advanced ore.
- Both entrances start sealed (a hardwood stump and a large boulder).

THE HIDDEN CELLAR
- An elevator behind the house leads to an abandoned wooden cellar with a hot spring and a waterfall.
- Standing in the spring restores energy and health.
- A minecart on the game's own network connects the cellar to the quarry and the other minecarts once they are unlocked.

THE MEMORIAL GARDEN
- A quiet garden across a footbridge with a monument thanking ConcernedApe and Yasuhiro Wada. Click the monument for the first time and you find a framed painting hidden within it to hang in your home.
- Regrowing hardwood stumps nearby.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
- SMAPI 4.0 or newer
- Content Patcher (required)
- Farm Type Manager (required, it spawns the quarry ore, geodes, worms and regrowing stumps)[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- ConcernedApe (Eric Barone), for Stardew Valley and for the valley we all call home.
- Yasuhiro Wada, creator of Harvest Moon, and the makers of Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town, for the farm this was built to honour.
- Esca, for Farm Type Manager.
- Pathoschild, for SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Everyone who plays it. I hope it feels like home.[/color]
